source.name: Volkswagen maintenance schedule
source.note: Read from the newest revision of Volkswagen's 2022 USA maintenance schedule, the jobs that apply to the Passat, in Glovebox's wording. Check it against the booklet that came with your car.
source.basis: The mileages and jobs of Volkswagen's own USA maintenance schedule for its gasoline models, as filed with NHTSA, for a car the owner maintains; only the rows that apply to the Passat. Only those facts are taken; jobs are named in Glovebox's words and no text or layout is copied.
